courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水庫抽泥疏浚
related.transfer: 可遷移「模態質量與週期」與「附加水質量與週期」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水庫抽泥疏浚的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Modal mass and period" and "Added water mass and period" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reservoir dredging must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限；水庫抽泥疏浚則以串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries; Reservoir dredging centres on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「模態質量與週期」與「測深網格與挖方」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水庫抽泥疏浚，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沉澱面積與表面負荷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Modal mass and period” and “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reservoir dredging, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Settling area and surface loading", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限；水力模型縮尺試驗則以用相似律與量測證據分辨水工縮尺模型可代表哪些現象為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries; Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures centres on use similitude and measurement evidence to define what hydraulic scale models represent, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「模態質量與週期」與「幾何比例與控制長度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水力模型縮尺試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雷諾數與黏滯失真」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Modal mass and period” and “Geometry ratio and reference length”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Reynolds number and viscous distortion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水壩地震動力分析
history.text: 水壩耐震方法隨結構型式及材料機制而分化，不能以一套線性振子概括所有壩。胡佛壩官方歷史記錄一九三五年主壩混凝土澆置完成，西斯克壩則在一九六三至一九六七年建成分區土石結構，兩者在此只作材料與幾何比較。工兵團二〇〇三年手冊整理混凝土水工結構線彈性歷時分析，墾務局二〇一五年土石壩耐震章節另處理相關土壤行為。課程以可追溯出版紀錄說明方法範圍，不宣稱原創質量、剛度或孔壓值曾在這些工程量得，也不把古老工程完成年份視為現行耐震驗證。
history.textEn: Seismic methods differ with structural form and material mechanism; one linear oscillator cannot describe every dam. Hoover’s official history records completion of main-dam concrete in1935, while Sisk was built as a zoned embankment during1963–1967. They are used only for material and geometry comparison. The2003 USACE manual addresses linear-elastic time histories for concrete hydraulic structures, while Reclamation’s2015 embankment chapter addresses relevant soil behavior. Publication history defines scope, without presenting synthetic masses, stiffnesses or pore pressures as measurements at these landmarks or treating historical completion as current seismic verification.
